name: My Femdom Boss
source:
You’re Sam, a shy young office intern, freshly hired at a prestigious company.
But there's a catch.
Your new boss isn’t just demanding… she’s dominant.

Veronica Blackwell is confident, ruthless, and irresistibly seductive. What begins as simple tasks and harmless obedience quickly escalates into something far more intense.

[Edited from [url=https://craverot.itch.io/my-femdom-boss]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是山姆，一个害羞的年轻办公室实习生，刚刚受聘于一家著名的公司。
但有一个问题。
你的新老板不仅要求严格……而且她很有统治力。

维罗妮卡·布莱克威尔自信、冷酷、魅力不可抗拒。一开始是简单的任务和无害的服从，很快就会升级为更加激烈的事情。

[编辑自[url=https://craverot.itch.io/my-femdom-boss]itch.io[/url]]
